skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply vocabulary at B2 level on specific and abstract topics.
Apply grammar structures at B2 level on specific and abstract topics.
Comprehend complex dialogues and presentations on specific and abstract topics, including technical exchanges within their field of expertise.
Communicate fluently and naturally, demonstrating discussion skills such as expressing opinions, agreeing/disagreeing, explaining, and debating on course topics.
Develop critical thinking skills, use technology to search and synthesize information, identify and solve problems, and develop multimedia communication skills.

Develop independent study skills and self-study abilities, demonstrate personal responsibility and teamwork, present and defend personal viewpoints based on objective scientific approaches, and show social responsibility when making judgments and evaluations.
Work independently and in groups, demonstrating teamwork and collaboration skills.
